name: suppressMessages
title: Return a value and muffle matching messages

origin.description: A condition that is returned, rather than raised, is left as it is.

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: A callable, or a value to return.

origin.details: A raised condition whose class matches is muffled and the call returns nothing. The check passes a message condition through without raising it.
